businesses.business: homebuilding and residential real estate services

offering_description.value: Dream Finders Homes builds and sells new homes to first-time, move-up and luxury buyers. It acquires lots, coordinates construction through trade contractors and sells homes through community sales teams and real estate agents. It also provides mortgage origination, title insurance and closing services.

primary_products.value: detached single-family homes; townhomes; custom luxury homes

primary_services.value: residential mortgage origination; title insurance; escrow and closing services

customer_segment.value: B2C: first-time, move-up and luxury homebuyers, including mortgage and closing clients; B2B: secondary-market investors that purchase originated residential mortgages

end_markets.value: new residential housing; residential mortgage lending; real estate title and settlement

revenue_model.value: product sales: completed new homes sold to homebuyers; transaction or usage fees: residential mortgage origination fees; service fees: escrow and closing services; commissions or management fees: title insurance agency commissions; other: sales of originated mortgages to secondary-market investors
revenue_model.category: product sales; transaction or usage fees; service fees; commissions or management fees; other

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: coordinates trade contractors to build homes on acquired lots for homebuyers; financial intermediary: originates mortgages for homebuyers and sells loans to secondary-market investors; service provider: uses property records and transaction documents to arrange title coverage and closings for homebuyers
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; financial intermediary; service provider

geography_served.value: US regional: selected markets in the Southeast and Mid-Atlantic, plus Texas and Colorado

specialization.value: related lines: entry-level through luxury homebuilding, mortgage origination, title insurance and settlement services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house new-home sales teams; own locations: model homes and sales centers in residential communities; agents / brokers: independent real estate agents representing homebuyers; online: company website with community listings, available homes and sales inquiries
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; own locations; agents / brokers; online

regulatory_exposure.value: high: local building permits and codes, state mortgage and title agency licensing, and federal mortgage consumer protection rules
